purpose: Debt record, not approval. Each entry is a submission package whose manifest no longer describes its own source. Recorded so CI can fail on new staleness without first failing on staleness that predates the check.
not_to_be_regenerated: Refreshing a package manifest to match moved source while retaining current-package authority deletes the evidence that the package is no longer what it claims to be. Staleness reaches zero only after a real rebuild or an explicit SUPERSEDED reconciliation that retains historical render evidence and denies current submission authority; never by an unqualified hash-only rewrite.

orion-05-tare-expressivity.note: Recorded as debt, not as approval. This package's SHA256SUMS writes repo-root-relative paths (.github/workflows/..., papers/orion-05-.../...), while every other tracked package writes paper-root-relative paths (journal_package/MANIFEST.json). The survey resolves against the majority convention, which is why all 40 entries read as missing. Resolved from the repo root instead, the real state is 25 matching, 12 drifted and 3 absent (.github/workflows/orion05-wave1-closeout.yml, journal_package/manuscript.pdf, tests/unit/publication/test_orion05_wave1_manuscript_surface.py). Reconciling this package means settling the path convention first; the 40 is a measurement artefact of the mismatch and must not be read as forty lost files.
